articles.title: Quote of the day by psychoanalysis founder Sigmund Freud: 'Humans want to be with the person they love but refuse to admit openly. Some are afraid to...' - Why people hide their feelings even when they deeply want love explained by the Austrian neurologist
articles.description: Sigmund Freud’s quote explores the complicated relationship between love, fear and emotional vulnerability. It suggests that people may deeply want to be with someone they love but hesitate to express their feelings because they fear rejection or discovering that their affection is not returned. The quote also examines why people sometimes remain emotionally connected to someone even when the attachment causes them pain.

articles.title: In 2005, Ricky Schroder bought a 30-acre Topanga ranch with organic gardens and orchards; 14 years later, the estate sold for $9.3 million after a long family stay there
articles.description: Actor Ricky Schroder and his wife, designer-entrepreneur Andrea Schroder, have sold their longtime Topanga ranch for $9.3 million, records show. The equestrian compound consists of three parcels totaling close to 30 acres and includes a Spanish-style main house, guest house, organic gardens, orchards, trails, a barn, and riding ring. The Schroders acquired the property in 2005 after returning to the Los Angeles area from Colorado, seeking space for their children and animals, according to the Los Angeles Times. The property was sold outside the Multiple Listing Service, with Aaron Kirman of Compass handling both sides of the deal.
